Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0034, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0035 1. Remark 2.1\group generalized-fixed-points

By rescaling in the soliton equation, one may assume that the parameter $\lambda $ is one of $-1,0,1$. These cases correspond respectively to shrinking, steady, and expanding solitons.
